title: Is ChatGPT a Boon or a Bane for Learning? Experimental Evidence Across Task Formats and Chatbot Designs
affiliations: School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China, University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management and University of Minnesota - Twin Cities

detail.title: Is ChatGPT a Boon or a Bane for Learning? Experimental Evidence Across Task Formats and Chatbot Designs
detail.abstract: As concerns mount over widespread use of large language model (LLM)-based chatbots for schoolwork worldwide, our understanding remains limited regarding their effects on learning and how to customize LLM chatbots and learning tasks to promote effective learning in the era of generative AI. To address these issues, we conducted a randomized field experiment among college students, randomly assigning each participant to one of three tools during a practice session: a Bing-based search engine, a standard ChatGPT chatbot, or a custom ChatGPT chatbot designed using the guide-discovery principle through zero-shot prompting. Using subsequent paper-and-pencil exams to measure learning outcomes, we found that students provided with the standard ChatGPT scored 4.18% lower on exams than those provided with Bing, despite being 3.8 times more likely to use the ChatGPT tool. Interestingly, the negative effect of the standard ChatGPT was limited to selected-response problems, with positive effects observed for constructedresponse problems. In contrast, students provided with the guided-discovery ChatGPT scored 9.23% higher on exams and outperformed the standard ChatGPT on both selected-response and constructed-response problems, an outcome attributable to extended practice time, more conversation rounds, and greater critical engagement. Finally, post-survey responses revealed that students overestimated the learning benefits of the standard ChatGPT and relied on it more heavily, despite recognizing the advantages of the guideddiscovery ChatGPT, highlighting the risk of overreliance on standard LLM chatbots.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了三种工具（Bing搜索、标准ChatGPT、引导式ChatGPT）对大学生学习效果的影响，发现标准ChatGPT导致考试成绩下降4.18%，而引导式ChatGPT则提高成绩9.23%，揭示了标准LLM聊天机器人的过度依赖风险
AI.research_question: LLM聊天机器人如何影响学习效果？如何定制LLM聊天机器人和学习任务以促进生成式AI时代的有效学习？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM聊天机器人在学业中的广泛使用，对其学习效果的理解仍然有限，需要研究如何优化这些工具来促进有效学习
AI.theoretical_framework: 引导发现原则（guided-discovery principle），通过零样本提示技术设计定制化ChatGPT
AI.method: 在大学生中进行的随机现场实验，将参与者随机分配到三种工具组（Bing搜索、标准ChatGPT、引导式ChatGPT），使用纸笔考试测量学习成果
AI.findings: 1) 标准ChatGPT组比Bing组考试成绩低4.18%；2) 标准ChatGPT对选择题有负面影响，对建构题有正面影响；3) 引导式ChatGPT组比Bing组高9.23%，在所有题型上都优于标准ChatGPT；4) 引导式ChatGPT的优势归因于更长的练习时间、更多对话轮次和更强的批判性参与
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了引导发现原则在LLM定制中的有效性，揭示了标准LLM聊天机器人的学习风险机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者提供了设计有效LLM学习工具的具体方法，警示学生避免过度依赖标准聊天机器人

title: Authority versus Peer Cues on Food Literacy Apps: Which Matter More for Healthy Choices and When?
affiliations: Sogang University, Samsung, National University of Singapore (NUS) and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: Authority versus Peer Cues on Food Literacy Apps: Which Matter More for Healthy Choices and When?
detail.abstract: Food literacy mobile apps provide two key information cues about food products i.e., expert nutrition grades (authority cues) and user ratings (peer cues). These cues have different implications for users, especially since relying on authority cues can lead to healthier food choices. Yet, it is unclear which cues influence users more and under what conditions, especially when the cues are incongruent. Drawing on the heuristic model and utilizing a unique clickstream dataset of 9,906 food products over 94 weeks from a major food literacy mobile app, we examine the main effects and interaction effects of both types of cues on the aggregate choice of food products. Employing a regression discontinuity design and panel regression analysis, we find a complementary effect of the two cues where authority cues are more influential for healthier food product choice while peer cues matter more when selecting less nutritious products. To uncover the mechanisms behind our findings, we analyze the influence of both cues for major versus minor brand products and conduct topic modeling of user reviews. These analyses indicate that credibility signals and credence attributes explain the effect of authority cues, while experience attributes such as food taste explain the influence of peer cues. We contribute to the online information processing and mHealth literatures by explicating the differential impacts of authority versus peer cues on users' choices for products that are uniquely characterized as search, experience, and credence goods. We discuss the implications of our findings for policy makers and mobile app designers.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨食品素养移动应用中专家营养等级（权威线索）和用户评分（同伴线索）对用户食品选择的影响，发现两种线索存在互补效应：权威线索对健康食品选择影响更大，同伴线索对营养较差产品更重要。
AI.research_question: 权威线索和同伴线索如何影响用户在食品素养移动应用中的产品选择？特别是在线索不一致的情况下，哪种线索影响更大？
AI.motivation: 食品素养移动应用提供权威和同伴两种信息线索，依赖权威线索可能带来更健康的食品选择，但尚不清楚哪种线索影响更大以及在什么条件下影响更大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 启发式模型、搜索品-体验品-信任品理论框架
AI.method: 使用来自主要食品素养移动应用的9,906种食品产品94周的点击流数据，采用断点回归设计和面板回归分析
AI.findings: 两种线索存在互补效应：权威线索对健康食品选择影响更大，同伴线索对营养较差产品更重要；权威线索的影响机制与可信度信号和信任属性相关，同伴线索的影响与体验属性（如口味）相关
AI.theory_contributions: 为在线信息处理和移动健康文献做出贡献，阐明权威与同伴线索对搜索品、体验品和信任品选择的不同影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和移动应用设计师提供实践启示

title: Title - Bridging the Deployment Gap: An Integrated Web Analytics and ML Framework for Operational Customer Churn Prediction
affiliations: University of Bolton

detail.title: Title - Bridging the Deployment Gap: An Integrated Web Analytics and ML Framework for Operational Customer Churn Prediction
detail.abstract: The issue of customer churn is a prominent problem in e-commerce because it is cheaper to keep customer than to get new ones. Though web analytics tools provide informative descriptive data on customer behavior, they do not provide predictive features to alert businesses of customers that are losing interest. This proof-of-concept study will provide a framework, combining web analytics items with machine learning that can predict customer churn and then display the results via an interactive dashboard. To illustrate this study, this method trained an XGBoost model on a synthetic dataset that simulated e-commerce customer activity achieving substantial performance (ROC-AUC = 0.996, F1-score = 0.944). To help merge predictive modeling and business implementation, this study offered the model from the dashboard to predict customer churn in real time, segment high-risk customers, and provide visualization of features of importance for non-technical users. The value of this research was not in providing new algorithm, but rather demonstrating what is possible when behavioral data, machine learning, and basic business intelligence tools are connected into a end-to-end workflow. Future research using real-world datasets could help extend model development at the operational layer of churn prediction systems however results used simulated data framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个结合网络分析数据和机器学习的框架，用于预测电子商务客户流失，并通过交互式仪表板展示结果。使用XGBoost模型在模拟数据集上取得了优异性能（ROC-AUC = 0.996，F1-score = 0.944），并展示了如何将预测模型与业务实施相结合。
AI.research_question: 如何利用网络分析数据和机器学习技术预测电子商务客户流失，并实现有效的业务应用？
AI.motivation: 客户流失是电子商务的突出问题，因为保留客户的成本低于获取新客户。现有网络分析工具仅提供描述性数据，缺乏预测功能来预警客户流失风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于客户关系管理和预测分析理论，结合网络行为分析与机器学习技术构建预测框架。
AI.method: 概念验证研究，使用XGBoost机器学习模型在模拟电子商务客户活动数据集上进行训练和测试。
AI.findings: 模型在模拟数据集上表现出色（ROC-AUC = 0.996，F1-score = 0.944），通过仪表板实现了实时客户流失预测、高风险客户细分和特征重要性可视化。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了行为数据、机器学习和商业智能工具整合为端到端工作流程的可能性，为预测性客户流失管理提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非技术用户提供了实用的客户流失预测工具，帮助企业提前识别流失风险客户并采取干预措施。

title: The Effect of PCI DSS Implementation on Customer Retention and Fraud Prevention in E-Commerce Platforms from E-store Owners’ Viewpoints
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Effect of PCI DSS Implementation on Customer Retention and Fraud Prevention in E-Commerce Platforms from E-store Owners’ Viewpoints

keywords.keywords: PCI DSS - Customer Retention - Fraud Prevention - E-Commerce Platforms - E-store Owners

detail.abstract: The research sought to determine the reality of implementing data security standards in "the electronic payment card industry" and discussed the significance of customer retention and fraud prevention in e-commerce platforms. The researcher would verify the statistically significant effect of implementing PCI DSS standards on customer retention and fraud prevention at (α ≤ 0.05) significance level. The researcher used the descriptive approach. The population included all E-store owners in the Saudi Kingdom. The research sample was drawn using simple random sampling, containing 377 individuals from the research population. The results revealed that implementing data security standards in the electronic payment card industry was critical. There was a real need for customer retention and fraud prevention in E-Commerce platforms. A statistically significant effect was found for implementing PCI DSS standards on customer retention. Furthermore, implementing PCI DSS standards explained 75.8% of the variance in customer retention. The study recommended developing security systems to evaluate financial transactions continuously to detect abnormal behavior. The researcher also recommended regularly updating and maintaining security systems to keep pace with evolving threats and maintain the security and confidentiality of data.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了在沙特王国实施PCI DSS数据安全标准对电子商务平台客户保留和欺诈预防的显著影响，发现PCI DSS标准实施解释了75.8%的客户保留方差。
AI.research_question: 实施电子支付卡行业数据安全标准（PCI DSS）对电子商务平台的客户保留和欺诈预防是否具有统计显著性影响？
AI.motivation: 电子商务平台面临数据安全挑战，客户保留和欺诈预防对平台成功至关重要，需要验证PCI DSS标准实施的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据安全标准理论、客户保留理论和欺诈预防理论，构建PCI DSS标准实施与业务绩效的关系框架。
AI.method: 采用描述性研究方法，通过简单随机抽样从沙特王国所有电子商店所有者中选取377人作为研究样本，在α≤0.05显著性水平下进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 实施PCI DSS标准对客户保留具有统计显著性影响，解释了75.8%的客户保留方差；数据安全标准在电子支付卡行业实施至关重要；电子商务平台确实需要客户保留和欺诈预防措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了PCI DSS标准实施与客户保留之间的因果关系，丰富了数据安全标准对业务绩效影响的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子商务平台提供了实施PCI DSS标准的具体建议，包括开发持续评估金融交易的安防系统、定期更新维护安全系统以应对不断演变的威胁。

title: Profit Maximization in Monopoly Durable Goods Markets with Word of Mouth
affiliations: Ernst-Abbe-Hochschule Jena, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Ernst-Abbe-Hochschule Jena

detail.title: Profit Maximization in Monopoly Durable Goods Markets with Word of Mouth
detail.abstract: This article investigates how consumers' willingness to participate in Word of Mouth (WoM) communication influences profit-maximizing prices and resulting profits. We develop a novel model of WoM in monopoly durable goods markets which establishes the relationship between WoM intensity, prices and profit and supports decisions about the design of WoM campaigns. Our model yields three key insights. First, the profit-maximizing price in markets with WoM is lower than in markets that rely on conventional advertising strategies, such as online or traditional offline advertising. Second, the relationship between the WoM intensity and the profit-maximizing price is U-shaped with exactly one minimum for moderate WoM intensities. Third, WoM yields higher profits than conventional advertising strategies for high information costs and high WoM intensities. Our model finally facilitates the development of referral strategies. These findings contribute to the theory and practice of electronic markets by providing a comprehensive understanding of the implementation of WoM campaigns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究消费者参与口碑传播的意愿如何影响垄断耐用消费品市场中的利润最大化价格和利润，建立了口碑强度、价格和利润之间的关系模型，发现口碑营销相比传统广告策略能带来更低的最优价格和更高利润。
AI.research_question: 消费者参与口碑传播的意愿如何影响垄断耐用消费品市场中的利润最大化价格和最终利润？
AI.motivation: 研究口碑营销在电子市场中的实施效果，为企业设计口碑营销活动提供决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垄断耐用消费品市场中的口碑传播模型，建立口碑强度、价格和利润之间的理论关系。
AI.method: 开发新颖的口碑传播数学模型，分析口碑强度对价格和利润的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 口碑市场的最优价格低于传统广告市场；2) 口碑强度与最优价格呈U型关系；3) 高信息成本和高口碑强度下，口碑营销利润高于传统广告。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电子市场理论提供了对口碑营销活动实施的全面理解，建立了口碑传播的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计口碑营销活动提供决策支持，有助于制定推荐策略，提高营销效果和利润。

title: Who Pays, Who Benefits? Producer-Insurer Games in Life-Saving Medicines
affiliations: University of Zurich, University of Zurich and University of Zurich

detail.title: Who Pays, Who Benefits? Producer-Insurer Games in Life-Saving Medicines
detail.abstract: Pharmaceutical markets for life-saving therapies combine monopoly power with insurance coverage. We build a tractable sequential game in which a patent-holder chooses the drug price, a profit-maximising insurer sets its premium, and a population of heterogeneous agents decide whether to insure and, conditional on diagnosis, whether to purchase treatment. Two sufficient statistics-subjective illness probability and reservation price-capture heterogeneity and nest risk-aversion and liquidity-constraint motives within a unified framework. We prove existence of subgame-perfect Nash equilibria and show that entry of an insurer strictly raises producer profits but may raise or lower both drug prices and treatment uptake, depending on the joint distribution of the population statistics. Numerical experiments calibrated to flexible parametric families illustrate non-monotone comparative statics and quantify conditions under which insurance reduces access. Our results provide benchmarks for evaluating price negotiations, price caps, and subsidy schemes in high-cost drug markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个关于救命药物市场的序列博弈模型，分析专利持有者、保险公司和消费者之间的互动关系，发现保险进入会提高生产者利润，但对药物价格和治疗使用率的影响取决于人口统计分布。
AI.research_question: 保险进入救命药物市场如何影响药物定价、治疗使用率和生产者利润？
AI.motivation: 救命药物市场具有垄断特性和保险覆盖的特殊性，需要理解保险机制在这种市场中的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序列博弈理论、纳什均衡、主观疾病概率和保留价格作为异质性统计指标的统一框架
AI.method: 构建可处理的序列博弈模型，进行数值实验校准参数化分布
AI.findings: 保险进入严格提高生产者利润，但对药物价格和治疗使用率的影响不确定，取决于人口统计分布
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了捕捉风险规避和流动性约束动机的统一框架，证明了子博弈完美纳什均衡的存在性
AI.practical_contributions: 为高成本药物市场的价格谈判、价格上限和补贴方案评估提供了基准

title: The Receptive and Resilient Leader: Thriving in an Era of AI and Digital Disruption
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business, City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business and Brooklyn College Department of Business Management

detail.title: The Receptive and Resilient Leader: Thriving in an Era of AI and Digital Disruption
detail.abstract: In an Age of Chaos, a term often used to describe the digital AI age, with its explosive growth of information and disruptive technology, businesses face unprecedented turbulence. This paper examines the essential leadership qualities required for success in this environment, arguing that traditional leadership, as seen in the decline of Kodak, Sears, and Blockbuster, struggles to adapt to rapid technological and market shifts. We identify several key competencies for leaders in the digital age: fostering agility, championing an ethical culture, pursuing purpose-driven goals, maintaining technological competency, and genuinely understanding diversity. Perhaps most crucial is receptive leadership, which embodies humility, empathy, active listening, and appreciation of others, thereby promoting a culture of productive dissent. These qualities empower leaders to transform rigid organizations into adaptable, powerful entities. The paper also highlights visionary myopia, a leader's failure to see threats and opportunities outside their traditional industry, as a particularly critical flaw in today's landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字AI时代混沌环境中企业领导者所需的关键素质，认为传统领导力无法适应快速的技术和市场变化，提出了包括培养敏捷性、倡导道德文化、追求目标驱动、保持技术能力和真正理解多样性等关键能力，特别强调接受型领导力的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在数字AI时代的混沌环境中，企业领导者需要具备哪些关键素质才能成功？
AI.motivation: 传统领导力模式（如柯达、西尔斯、百视达等公司的衰落所示）在快速技术变革和市场动荡中表现不佳，企业需要新的领导力范式来应对数字时代的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于接受型领导力理论，强调谦逊、同理心、积极倾听和欣赏他人等品质，以及愿景短视理论，指领导者无法看到传统行业之外的威胁和机会。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，通过对柯达、西尔斯、百视达等传统企业衰落的案例分析，推导出数字时代领导力的关键要素。
AI.findings: 识别出五个关键领导力素质：培养组织敏捷性、倡导道德文化、追求目标驱动、保持技术能力、真正理解多样性；其中接受型领导力最为关键，能够促进建设性异议文化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于数字AI时代的领导力理论框架，特别是接受型领导力概念和愿景短视理论，丰富了现代领导力理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业领导者提供了具体的实践指导，帮助他们在混沌环境中将僵化组织转变为适应性强、有竞争力的实体。

title: Optimal Contracting with Aspirational Utility
affiliations: University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics, Boston University - Questrom School of Business and University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics

detail.title: Optimal Contracting with Aspirational Utility
detail.abstract: This paper characterizes the optimal dynamical contract when the agent features aspirational utility as described by Diecidue and Van der Ven (2008). We extend the seminal dynamic principal-agent framework of Sannikov (2008) to characterize the optimal contract when the agent features an aspiration point. There are three important results. The compensation contract discontinuously jumps after good performance to reach the aspiration point. It is constant around the aspiration point for many histories, and only continues to increase after a substantially good history is realized. Second, even though consumption exhibits very low PPS around the aspiration point, the net present value of consumption displays high PPS around that level. Third, the implemented effort is very high around the aspiration point. Because the agent is risk-loving in this region, the usual trade-off between risk-sharing and incentives is muted and the optimal contract features very high incentives. Right below the aspiration the agent is incentivized to reach the aspirational level by being exposed to a large share of the project's risk. Finally, we discuss the implications for optimal contracts with multiple aspirational thresholds and for instances in which the agent can engage in risk-taking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当代理人具有抱负效用时的最优动态合约，发现在抱负点附近补偿合约会跳跃性增长，消费呈现低PPS但净现值显示高PPS，且努力水平非常高。
AI.research_question: 当代理人具有抱负效用时，最优动态合约的特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 将Sannikov（2008）的动态委托-代理框架扩展到具有抱负点的代理人情境，探讨抱负效用对最优合约设计的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Diecidue和Van der Ven（2008）的抱负效用理论和Sannikov（2008）的动态委托-代理框架。
AI.method: 理论建模和数学推导，扩展动态合约框架来分析抱负点对最优合约的影响。
AI.findings: 1）补偿合约在良好业绩后会跳跃性增长至抱负点；2）抱负点附近消费PPS低但净现值PPS高；3）抱负点附近努力水平非常高；4）抱负点下方代理人承担更大风险以激励达到抱负水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了动态合约理论，首次系统分析了抱负效用对最优合约设计的影响，揭示了抱负点附近独特的激励特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计考虑代理人心理因素的激励合约提供了理论指导，特别是在需要高激励的情境下。

declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation (Project 201958).

detail.abstract: We study how renters trade off rent and utility bill estimates in apartment choice, combining Swiss listings with administrative billing data. Using two complementary empirical strategies, a quasi-experimental and Double Machine Learning approach, we find renters respond to both components but place more weight on utility bill estimates than on rent. Utility bill estimates are generally accurate yet slow to adjust during price shocks. Rental elasticities are muted in tight markets and stronger for smaller units. These results show how apartments' operating-cost information influences demand and can inform analyses of rent regulation, disclosure rules, carbon pricing, and efficiency incentives.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨租户在公寓选择时如何权衡租金与水电费估算，结合瑞士公寓挂牌数据与行政账单数据，发现租户对水电费估算的反应强于租金，水电费估算通常准确但价格冲击时调整缓慢。

detail.title: Predictive Algorithms for Apartment Rental Demand using Multimodal Data
detail.abstract: The development of online platforms to advertise rental apartments results in the generation of an extensive corpus of data. These data include detailed apartment attributes, textual descriptions, and visual representations through images. This amount of data represents an opportunity to gain insights into the factors that capture the interest of potential tenants. The aim of this paper is to predict the demand for a given listing through predictive machine learning algorithms. We define demand as the number of potential tenants who express interest in the apartment through an online form.

title: LLM Survey Framework: Coverage, Consistency, Identification
affiliations: The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Center for Forecasting Science and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Economics

detail.title: LLM Survey Framework: Coverage, Consistency, Identification
detail.abstract: We propose a new LLM-based survey framework with broad applications for studying expectations. It introduces three innovations beyond traditional surveys: (1) retrospective coverage, enabling analysis across decades and at higher frequencies; (2) internal consistency, fixing personas across control and treatment arms and waves, and treatments over time; and (3) clean identification, freezing the knowledge set at the survey date and introducing factual treatments released afterward. We validate it in a multi-wave randomized controlled trial of inflation expectations surveys, and recover human-comparable treatment effects. Leveraging our new framework, we extend the benchmark human survey (10 waves, 2018-2023) to over 50 waves dating back to 1990, demonstrating how LLM surveys unlock designs unattainable with human surveys.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的新型调查框架，用于研究期望形成，具有回溯覆盖、内部一致性和清洁识别三大创新特点，并通过通胀期望调查验证了该框架的有效性。

AI.method: 多波次随机对照试验，采用LLM代理进行通胀期望调查，比较与传统人类调查的结果。
AI.findings: LLM调查框架能够产生与人类调查可比的处理效应，并能扩展到更长历史时期和更高频率的调查。

AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可应用于多种期望研究场景的实用调查工具，扩展了调查的时间维度和设计可能性。

title: Concentration with Convergence: Regional Productivity Patterns in Turkiye, 1950-2020

detail.title: Concentration with Convergence: Regional Productivity Patterns in Turkiye, 1950-2020
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive long-run analysis of regional productivity convergence in Turkey using a novel dataset combining newly compiled employment estimates with recent output estimates. The seven-decade analysis reveals substantial productivity convergence driven by labor reallocation away from agriculture alongside within-industry convergence. A distinctive pattern emerges: aggregate economic concentration proceeded hand-in-hand with productivity convergence, with distinct regional clusters forming, though the Eastern low-productivity cluster dissolved after 2000. Furthermore, shift-share decomposition shows industry-mix effects persistently explain significant regional productivity variation, reflecting sustained agriculture-other sectors productivity differences, with western regions enjoying both favorable sectoral composition and regional competitiveness advantages. From a policy perspective, agricultural productivity improvements offer significant potential for reducing regional disparities.

AI.tldr: 本文对土耳其地区生产力趋同进行了长达70年的综合分析，发现生产力趋同主要由劳动力从农业重新配置以及行业内趋同驱动。研究发现经济集中与生产力趋同同步进行，东部低生产力集群在2000年后消失。行业结构效应持续解释显著的区域生产力差异，农业生产力提升对减少区域差距具有重要政策意义。

title: Artisanal and Small-scale Gemstone Mining: Socio-economic and Environmental Perspectives in Taita Taveta County, Kenya

detail.title: Artisanal and Small-scale Gemstone Mining: Socio-economic and Environmental Perspectives in Taita Taveta County, Kenya

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The approval to conduct the study was given by the Taita Taveta County’s Mines and Geological Office. A participant consent form with details of the study was presented to eligible participants for signing before an interview started. The signing of the consent form by eligible participants, was proof that they agreed to participate in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was provided for this study.

detail.abstract: Artisanal and small-scale gemstone mining in Taita Taveta County has received little research on its socio-environmental impact. Consequently, this study investigated the socio-environmental impacts of the activity contributing on the existing literature. Data was obtained from both primary and secondary sources. The findings suggest that the activity is fundamental in supporting the livelihoods of the locals both directly and indirectly. Nonetheless, some socio-environmental problems like drug abuse, human rights violations, family instability and environmental degradation were revealed. Poor gemstone market systems, inadequate government support and rudimentary technology were notable challenges facing the sector. Elemental analysis of gemstone-bearing rock samples indicated the presence of silica, oxide forms of sulphur and iron, arsenic, chromium and lead. These have the potential of posing human health effects and environmental contamination. For achievement of a sustainable gemstone mining sector, responsible institutions should ensure strict enforcement and compliance with the mining and environmental regulatory framework.

title: A Novel Approach to Teaching Empathic Leadership using Heuristics
affiliations: University of Leicester, University of California, Berkeley, University of Oxford - Said Business School, IT University of Copenhagen, University of Leicester and University of Leicester

detail.title: A Novel Approach to Teaching Empathic Leadership using Heuristics

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants and instead describes the conduct and outputs of a workshop involving all contributing authors. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: JH and ABW are funded by the Stoneygate Trust. The funder had no role in designing or conducting this research.

detail.abstract:
Introduction: NHS failures at Mid-Staffordshire, Shrewsbury and Telford, and East Kent reached the same conclusion: leaders who fail to listen and understand put patients at risk. The NHS response has been to promote compassionate leadership. Yet compassion often entails emotional merging, which can blur boundaries and lead to fatigue. By contrast, empathic leadership, curiosity-driven perspective-taking rather than emotional merging, offers a way forward. Yet no practical method exists to teach it. We tested whether simple heuristics (“rules of thumb”) could fill this gap.

 

Methods: Twenty-one healthcare leaders attended a structured workshop. Using established heuristic development and curriculum design methods, participants generated, refined, and prioritised rules of thumb (heuristics) for empathic leadership, then co-designed a training course.

 

Results: The group produced 35 heuristics and prioritised 12 for teaching healthcare leaders, including “Listen first, speak last” and “Walk the shop floor.” A one-day interprofessional empathic leadership course for 25 participants was then co-designed, featuring experiential learning, roleplay, and implementation planning.

 

Conclusion: Addressing persistent failures in healthcare leadership while avoiding compassionate leadership's limitations, this study was able to prioritise heuristics for empathic leadership and co-design an innovative course to teach them.

title: When the Storm Decides: Crises, Perception, and Electoral Outcomes in the United States
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: When the Storm Decides: Crises, Perception, and Electoral Outcomes in the United States
detail.abstract: Crises function as inflection points in American politics. Terrorist attacks, hurricanes, pandemics, revolutions, and financial collapses disrupt the usual calculus of campaigns, forcing voters to judge leaders not by ideology but by perceived competence under stress. The Iranian Hostage Crisis destroyed Jimmy Carter's presidency and opened the door for Ronald Reagan. George W. Bush rose to overwhelming popularity after 9/11, only to collapse after Hurricane Katrina and the 2008 financial crash. Barack Obama capitalized on that vacuum, bolstered briefly by the killing of Osama bin Laden in 2011. Donald Trump entered 2020 with a plausible path to re-election, but the COVID-19 pandemic, George Floyd protests, and resulting mental health crisis destroyed his standing. Joe Biden, having won in 2020, then saw his legitimacy fractured by Hurricane Helene in 2024, which provided Donald Trump the narrative leverage to return to power. This paper argues that crises are not 'flukes' but recurring tests of competence in American democracy, with outcomes as decisive as debates, policies, or economic cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文认为危机是美国政治中的转折点，它们不是偶然事件，而是对领导人能力的反复考验，其结果与辩论、政策或经济周期一样具有决定性。

AI.motivation: 探讨危机事件如何改变竞选常规，迫使选民基于领导人在压力下的表现能力而非意识形态进行评判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危机政治理论、领导能力评估理论、选民决策理论
AI.method: 历史案例分析法，通过分析伊朗人质危机、9/11、卡特里娜飓风、COVID-19大流行等关键危机事件
AI.findings: 危机事件能够显著改变政治格局，摧毁或提升总统的政治地位，为政治对手创造机会
AI.theory_contributions: 提出危机作为系统性政治转折点的理论框架，强调能力评估在危机时刻的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政治战略家提供理解危机时刻选民行为模式的实用见解，帮助制定有效的危机应对策略

title: Social Media and Compulsive Buying: Psychological Insights into Instagram's Emerging Marketplace
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Social Media and Compulsive Buying: Psychological Insights into Instagram's Emerging Marketplace
detail.abstract: The rise of social media platforms has transformed consumer behavior, with Instagram emerging as a significant marketplace that blends social interaction with digital commerce. This paper examines the psychological dimensions of compulsive buying behavior in the context of Instagram's visual and interactive environment. By integrating insights from consumer psychology and behavioral sciences, the study highlights how algorithm-driven content exposure, influencer endorsements, and personalized advertising foster impulsive and compulsive purchasing tendencies. The role of social comparison, fear of missing out (FOMO), and instant gratification is explored to explain why consumers may exhibit diminished self-control in this digital space. Furthermore, the paper considers the ethical and marketing implications for businesses and policymakers, emphasizing the need for responsible advertising practices and consumer awareness. These insights contribute to the growing discourse on sustainable digital marketing strategies and the psychological vulnerabilities that shape online consumer decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Instagram平台上强迫性购买行为的心理维度，探讨了算法驱动的内容曝光、网红代言和个性化广告如何促进冲动和强迫性购买倾向，并分析了社会比较、错失恐惧症和即时满足等心理因素的作用。

title: At-Will America, Globalized R&D, and Physician Pay under 2025 Policy Shocks: An International Medical Student's Evidence-Based Assessment
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: At-Will America, Globalized R&D, and Physician Pay under 2025 Policy Shocks: An International Medical Student's Evidence-Based Assessment
detail.abstract: This paper synthesizes recent U.S. policy changes and labor-market realities to assess their implications for early-career physicians and STEM professionals trained in the United States and abroad. Using official statistics and primary documentation (BEA, NSF/NCSES, AAMC, DOL, CBO, KFF, ABR, CAMPEP, and USMLE program materials), I evaluate five claims that arise frequently in cross-border career discussions: (1) whether U.S. at-will employment implies the absence of labor protections; (2) whether U.S. multinationals have offshored the bulk of their R&D "brainpower"; (3) whether the USMLE's clinical emphasis disadvantages physicians relative to device-level biophysics; (4) whether 2025 federal policy-universal tariffs, tighter immigration rules, and significant Medicaid reductions-alters physician compensation via payer-mix shocks; and (5) whether training in Europe vs. the United States dominates, net of costs and residency goals. The evidence indicates that U.S. labor law features substantial protections alongside at‑will termination and WARN‑Act carve‑outs; that roughly 85% of U.S. MNC R&D spending remains onshore; that device‑physics depth is concentrated in radiology and medical physics curricula rather than USMLE; and that Medicaid cuts and tariff‑immigration shocks are likely to pressure compensation in Medicaid‑heavy or rural markets while leaving commercially heavy specialties less exposed. A pragmatic training strategy for international students emerges by aligning specialty and geography with payer mix, maintaining a publication record, and establishing an industry bridge (e.g., medical affairs) to mitigate policy risk.

AI.tldr: 本文评估美国政策变化对早期职业医生和STEM专业人士的影响，分析了五个常见主张，发现美国劳动法存在实质性保护、85%的跨国公司研发支出留在国内、设备物理知识集中在特定课程而非USMLE考试中，并提出了针对国际学生的实用培训策略。
AI.research_question: 美国政策变化和劳动力市场现实对在美国和国外接受培训的早期职业医生和STEM专业人士有何影响？
AI.motivation: 评估近期美国政策变化（如关税、移民规则收紧、医疗补助削减）对医疗和STEM领域专业人士职业发展的实际影响

detail.abstract: The Gondauri Index (GI) is introduced as a novel macro-financial composite index grounded in the Clay Millennium Problems and applied to economic modeling. It integrates three sub-indices: the Inequality-Ricci Subindex (IRS), measuring income distribution stability through Ricci flow dynamics; the Liquidity-Navier-Stokes Resilience (LNSR), capturing systemic robustness via fluid dynamics analogies; and the Inflation FPAS+ζ Credibility (IFC), enhancing inflation forecasting through hybrid FPAS-Riemann zeta methods. Each subindex is normalized on a 0-100 scale, with the final GI computed as a weighted geometric mean (35% IRS, 35% LNSR, 30% IFC). The methodology combines statistical calibration, normalization, and error-reduction benchmarks, ensuring reliability and policy applicability. The GI provides a consolidated, forward-looking metric for evaluating inequality, financial stability, and inflation expectations, offering policymakers and researchers a robust tool for decision-making in complex socioeconomic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了基于Clay Millennium Problems的Gondauri指数（GI），这是一个包含三个子指数的宏观金融综合指数：衡量收入分配稳定性的Inequality-Ricci Subindex（IRS）、评估系统稳健性的Liquidity-Navier-Stokes Resilience（LNSR）以及改进通胀预测的Inflation FPAS+ζ Credibility（IFC）。GI通过加权几何平均计算，为政策制定者提供评估不平等、金融稳定性和通胀预期的综合前瞻性指标。

AI.method: 采用统计校准、标准化和误差减少基准的方法，将三个子指数（IRS、LNSR、IFC）归一化到0-100尺度，并通过加权几何平均（35% IRS、35% LNSR、30% IFC）计算最终GI指数。
AI.findings: GI指数提供了一个整合的、前瞻性的指标，能够可靠地评估不平等、金融稳定性和通胀预期，具有政策适用性。

title: Semiparametrically Efficient Stepped Wedge Designs
affiliations: and Emory University

detail.title: Semiparametrically Efficient Stepped Wedge Designs
detail.abstract: We study the design of stepped wedge trials, where units are sequentially randomized to receive the treatment over multiple periods and remain treated thereafter. The design problem is to select unit-and period-specific treatment assignment probabilities to most precisely estimate the treatment effects that may vary with treatment exposure time. Existing approaches typically assume a parametric outcome model, derive an analytical variance formula for estimated treatment effects, and optimize assignments accordingly. Such model-based approaches can be sensitive to misspecification and yield suboptimal treatment assignments in practice. To address these concerns, we propose a novel design approach based on semiparametric theory. We first derive new semiparametric efficiency bounds for exposure-time-dependent treatment effects, and then use the bounds to guide the optimal design. Our framework relies on doubly robust augmented inverse probability weighting estimators, which remain consistent even if the outcome model is misspecified, because propensity scores are chosen by experimenters as part of the design. We identify four key factors influencing optimal designs: serial correlation in outcomes, causal estimand of interest, duration of carryover effects, and differences in variability of outcomes between treatment and control. Specifically, stronger serial correlation leads to more gradual rollouts, and longer carryover durations require earlier treatment assignment. Simulation and empirical results on mobile health data show that our designs reduce estimation error relative to state-of-the-art benchmarks by 18.4%.

declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge excellent research assistance from Cristóbal Pesqueira and financial support from Chile’s Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo (ANID) ANID/FONDAP 1522A0004.

detail.abstract:
The link between urban development and transportation is crucial for the social, environmental, and economic health of cities. Transport infrastructure is a key driver of urban growth, but its effects are intricate, varied, and often depend on the specific context. This paper systematically reviews empirical literature to synthesize causal evidence on how transport infrastructure shapes urban form. 
We specifically examine highways, urban rail, and Bus Rapid Transit (BRT). The review analyzes their documented impacts on quantifiable urban form metrics, such as floor space prices, population density, and suburbanization patterns. A major contribution of this work is the review of the main theoretical approaches to answer the question and the critical analysis of available empirical methods. 
Our methodology prioritizes studies using robust econometric strategies to identify and measure causal effects, thereby addressing the inherent endogeneity in the transport-land use system. The review is organized by infrastructure type and its specific impact, offering a comprehensive overview of current knowledge. This is, to our knowledge, the first review to systematically analyze causal evidence across these distinct dimensions. In addition to systematizing the evidence, the paper explores the distributional consequences of these investments to try moving beyond average effects. The synthesis of findings aims to provide clearer understanding for policymakers and urban planners, highlighting policy implications and suggesting avenues for future research to guide the development of more sustainable and equitable cities.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了交通基础设施（高速公路、城市轨道交通、BRT）对城市形态的因果影响，重点关注量化指标如房价、人口密度和郊区化模式，并分析了理论方法和实证策略。

AI.findings: 按基础设施类型和具体影响组织，提供了当前知识的全面概述。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析跨不同维度的因果证据，综述主要理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和城市规划者提供更清晰的理解，强调政策含义并建议未来研究方向，以指导更可持续和公平的城市发展。

title: Of Data and Dissent: Labour and Human Rights at the Crossroads of the Automation Agenda

detail.title: Of Data and Dissent: Labour and Human Rights at the Crossroads of the Automation Agenda
detail.abstract:
With every advent of a new technological phase — whether social media, big data, machine learning algorithms, or generative artificial intelligence (AI) — one fundamental task among many falls to legal scholars and practitioners, adjudicators, and lawmakers to confront: determining what the new technology changes, what it does not, and where and how the differences matter (legally and otherwise). To that end, this talk will address issues such as how algorithmic discrimination differs from “analogue” discrimination; how society and our laws should view human labour in a time when so much more of it seems instantly replicable by machines; and the connection between how automated decision-making works and proposed changes to liability frameworks when it comes to AI.

What will become clear through this discussion is one thing that has never changed: technology is about power. Questions of technology thus carry particular weight in contexts built around systemic power imbalances, whether as a matter of workplace relations or human rights law. Drawing on a panoply of work by lawyers, academics, researchers, and grassroots community experts in various interdisciplinary combinations of law, computer science, labour, human rights, science and technology studies, and algorithmic accountability scholarship, this keynote will challenge the audience to reconceptualize AI not as a “neutral tool” or coherent technical object, but as, to quote anthropologist and computer scientist Ali Alkhatib, “an ideological project to shift” power, and consider the consequences of ignoring what that means for our legal and human rights.

declarations.funderStatement: This work has been supported by the project CASIECO - CAlibrazione e SImulazione di un modello macroECOnomico di grandi dimensioni (Calibration and simulation of a large-scale macroeconomic model), funded by the SPOKE 7 EDGE-EXASCALE AI Cascade Call under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan, Mission 4 “Education and Research” – Component 2 “From Research to Business” – Investment 1.3 FAIR “Future Artificial Intelligence Research,” Code PE0000013, financed by the European Union – NextGenerationEU.

detail.abstract: We extend a large, heterogeneous agent-based economic simulation model (ABM), calibrated to real data and representing the Italian macroeconomic system, through the introduction of a multi-agent reinforcement learning mechanism for the price-setting behavior of firms, replacing the simple heuristics typically used in ABMs. We find that firms learn a mean-reverting price-setting behavior, adjusting prices in response to deviations from the sectoral average, which is consistent with both empirical observations and theoretical models. We then apply this behavior to different shares of firms and evaluate the forecasting performance on macroeconomic variables. Our results show that modeling the behavior of firms with reinforcement learning can improve the model's fit to macroeconomic data, but only in specific settings and if not all firms are set to learn.

detail.title: Strategic Under-reporting of Arsenic Contamination in Drinking Water
detail.abstract: Community water systems regulated by the Safe Drinking Water Act must regularly test their water and self-report their compliance status for a number of health standards. The penalties for failing to self-report are often much lower than those received by violating health standards. This creates a potential incentive to avoid a more costly violation by intentionally failing to self-report. We identify this strategic under-reporting of arsenic contamination by community water systems using a combination of time-invariant arsenic measures and the Final Arsenic Rule that lowered permissible levels of arsenic in drinking water.

detail.title: Beyond Open Access: Predicting Financial Advisor Misconduct Using Machine Learning
detail.abstract: This paper aims to help retail investors more effectively use information and tools to assess the risk of financial advisor (FA) misconduct. Using a Gradient-Boosted Decision Tree model, we show that a baseline model built on 25 regulatory variables predicts misconduct reasonably well. Adding firm-level variables, though requiring more effort, improves the model’s accuracy and efficiency, whereas county-, state-, or individual-level inputs offer less improvement. Firm-level inputs are also useful for predicting misconduct over a two- to three-year horizon, identifying recidivism, and flagging first-time offenses. Last, we develop Advisor Alert, an interactive tool that uses our model to predict FA misconduct. Overall, this study provides practical insights and tools to assist retail investors in identifying trustworthy FAs.

detail.title: Skilled labor mobility and bank default
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of skilled labor mobility risk on bank fragility. Using a novel measure of skilled labor mobility risk, we find that an increase in this risk raises the probability of bank default. The effect is more pronounced for banks facing higher competition and with a high proportion of non-performing loans. Further we show that labor mobility restriction laws can help mitigate the detrimental effect of skilled labor mobility risk. Our findings suggest that skilled labor mobility can exacerbate bank fragility, but proper policies can bolster resilience against possible adverse effects from labor market frictions.

title: How effective is emissions pricing? The role of firm-product-level adjustment

detail.title: How effective is emissions pricing? The role of firm-product-level adjustment
detail.abstract: Carbon emissions caused by industrial production are among the most important drivers of climate change. This paper analyzes how multi-product firms adjust to theintroduction of emissions pricing in terms of their output, product mix, and technology, and how their emissions change in response, depending on firm-specific production patternsand cost structures. My model delivers a qualitative and quantitative assessment of changes in aggregate emissions via conventional margins of firm adjustment that have not been sufficiently studied in the literature so far. In numerical simulations, I find that emissions pricing can significantly decrease emissions of multi-product firms.

title: Reconciling Eco and Ego? The interplay between environmental and image concerns in consumption choices
affiliations: University of Paris-Saclay and Institut National de la Recherche Agronomique

detail.title: Reconciling Eco and Ego? The interplay between environmental and image concerns in consumption choices
detail.abstract: We explore the interplay between two key individual drivers of green consumption: intrinsic moral concerns for the environment and reputational concerns for social image. Our microeconomic behavioral model characterizes choices among lifestyles differing in environmental impacts (brown/green) and conspicuousness (positional/discreet), depending on how strongly one values each of these motives. We show that image concerns can substitute for environmental concerns in driving green consumption across a limited but central range of preferences, in particular through the purchase of green positional goods. Such conspicuous conservation can green individual consumption (reconciling Eco and Ego), especially among image-sensitive consumers, but it yields environmental benefits only under specific economic conditions. Indeed, the environmental impact of a lifestyle depends critically on its relative impact intensity, i.e., the pollution per dollar spent on this lifestyle, more than on the pollution per unit of the representative good of the lifestyle, driving volume effects and behavioral rebound effects, which both reduce the environmental benefits of green lifestyles. Knowing the collective distribution of preferences may help design targeted policies, as those preferences strongly determine policy effectiveness. Our findings are especially relevant for policies that aim to foster greener consumption choices in different economic contexts (e.g., green nudging, environmental taxes with higher rates on positional goods...).
